name: knowledge-processing-expert
description: A technical and procedural standard element extraction expert: decomposes standards, their normative references and laboratory internal documents (SOP, QC procedures, instrument manuals) into executable specifications, dependency graphs and classified, clause-anchored audit rule cards with report-location hints for downstream audit experts.

profession.en: Technical & Procedural Standard Element Extraction Expert
profession.zh: 技术与流程标准要素抽取专家

displayDescription.en: Decomposes standards, referenced documents and lab SOPs into executable elements, dependency graphs and classified audit rules with report-text locator hints.
displayDescription.zh: 把标准、引用文件与实验室 SOP 解构为可执行要素、依赖图谱与分类审核规则，并给出报告文字定位线索，供审核专家逐条判定。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把这份标准（如 HJ 671—2013）解构成可执行流程、设备、试剂、公式和质控阈值，并生成可审核的规则卡。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Decompose this standard (e.g. HJ 671-2013) into executable procedures, apparatus, reagents, formulas and QC thresholds, and generate audit-ready rule cards.

quickPrompts.en: Decompose this standard (e.g. HJ 671-2013) into executable procedures, apparatus, reagents, formulas and QC thresholds, and generate audit-ready rule cards.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份标准（如 HJ 671—2013）解构成可执行流程、设备、试剂、公式和质控阈值，并生成可审核的规则卡。

quickPrompts.en: Map the standard's normative references and list the documents I still need to upload, with the clauses and rules each one affects.
quickPrompts.zh: 梳理标准的规范性引用关系，列出还需上传的文件，并写明各自影响哪些条款与规则。

quickPrompts.en: Link calibration, calculation, QC and result expression into a dependency graph with report-text locators so each reported value can be highlighted and traced back.
quickPrompts.zh: 把校准、计算、质控与结果表示串成带报告定位线索的依赖图，让报告上的每个数值都能被标注并反查来源。
